description: This file implements a socket-based communication interface for a message queue system, including server and client socket setup, request/response handling, and persistent connection management with auto-reconnect features.

methods.name: qm_conn_server
methods.description: Sets up a UNIX domain socket server, binds, and listens for incoming connections.

methods.name: qm_conn_accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection on the server socket.

methods.name: qm_conn_client
methods.description: Creates a UNIX domain socket client and connects to the server socket.

methods.name: qm_req_init
methods.description: Initializes a request structure with a unique sequence number and default values.

methods.name: qm_req_valid
methods.description: Validates a request structure based on tag and version.

methods.name: qm_conn_write_req
methods.description: Serializes and sends a request over a socket, merging small messages for efficiency.

methods.name: qm_conn_read_req
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a request from a socket.

methods.name: qm_res_init
methods.description: Initializes a response structure based on a request.

methods.name: qm_res_valid
methods.description: Validates a response structure based on tag and version.

methods.name: qm_conn_write_res
methods.description: Sends a response over a socket.

methods.name: qm_conn_read_res
methods.description: Reads and validates a response from a socket.

methods.name: qm_conn_get_status
methods.description: Sends a status request and waits for a response.

methods.name: qm_data_type_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a data type.

methods.name: qm_response_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a response type.

methods.name: qm_error_str
methods.description: Returns a string description of an error code.

methods.name: qm_conn_status_str
methods.description: Returns a string description of connection status.

methods.name: qm_conn_open_fd
methods.description: Opens a socket connection to the message queue server.

methods.name: qm_conn_send_fd
methods.description: Sends a request and optional data over a socket, handling response if needed.

methods.name: qm_conn_send_req
methods.description: Creates a socket connection, sends a request, and closes the socket.

methods.name: qm_conn_send_custom
methods.description: Sends a custom data type with specified compression and flags.

methods.name: qm_conn_send_raw
methods.description: Sends raw data without compression.

methods.name: qm_conn_send_direct
methods.description: Sends data directly with specified compression.

methods.name: qm_conn_send_stats
methods.description: Sends statistical data.

methods.name: qm_conn_open
methods.description: Initializes a persistent connection object for message queue communication.

methods.name: qm_conn_reopen
methods.description: Reopens a connection if it was previously closed.

methods.name: qm_conn_check_reconnect
methods.description: Checks socket health and reconnects if the socket is in a bad state.

methods.name: qm_conn_close
methods.description: Closes a persistent connection.

methods.name: qm_conn_send_stream
methods.description: Sends data over a persistent connection, with auto-reconnect on failure.

methods.name: qm_conn_send_log
methods.description: Sends a log message over a persistent connection.

methods.name: qm_conn_log_close
methods.description: Closes the log message connection.
